$comment: Defined in spec/08-transcripts.md §8.2 (Scribe Exchange Protocol v0.1)
title: TranscriptChunk
description: The text of one uploaded chunk. Returned by GET .../sources/{sid}/transcript/chunks/{n} and, under the put transport, as the response to the upload itself. Immutable once success.

audio_offset_ms.description: Start of this chunk on the audio timeline: summed length of chunks 0..n-1. null while an earlier chunk is missing.

received_at.description: When the bytes reached the service's storage (service clock).

recorded_at.description: Client clock for when the chunk was recorded, as sent with end. null until then.
